skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the role and importance of service quality management for businesses, customers, and the economy.
Understand and apply methods and techniques to evaluate service quality based on qualitative data from customer satisfaction surveys.
Analyze and apply theories to design service processes and service blueprints.
Evaluate and manage service delivery processes to ensure quality.
Analyze customer satisfaction and expectations, and develop strategies to enhance customer loyalty and handle complaints.
Implement quality control measures and evaluate service quality using various models.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Present findings and solutions effectively in group settings.
Apply critical thinking to analyze service quality issues and develop solutions.
Conduct independent research and apply findings to service quality management.
